title: No Offense Taken: Eliciting Offensiveness from Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using an automated red teaming approach where a 'Red LM' generates test prompts to elicit harmful responses from a 'Target LM'. The offensiveness of the resulting responses is evaluated using a Bot-Adversarial Dialogue Classifier trained on adversarial dialogues and Wikipedia Toxic Comments.

Using a sensitive topics classifier to measure the percentage of target LM responses that contain sensitive information. The classifier detects and aggregates responses across sensitive categories including Religion, Politics, Drugs, Medical Advice, and Relationships & Dating / NSFW.
